title: Therapeutic gases and the Nrf2/Keap1 pathway: direct thiol modification vs . indirect modulation

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Therapeutic gases and the Nrf2/Keap1 pathway: direct thiol modification vs . indirect modulation》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Introduction · section-2-p5】This review develops four arguments. First, NO and H2S activate Nrf2 primarily through direct or near-direct mechanisms involving cysteine modification, although the exact residue preference and downstream consequences depend on the local redox context. Second, H2 appears to influence the pathway mainly through indirect remodeling of upstream oxidative events, mitochondrial electron leakage, and secondary electrophile formation, rather than through a defined direct receptor-like interaction.1114 Third, all three gases converge on a shared layer of kinase signaling, proteostasis, and mitochondrial quality control that amplifies or stabilizes Nrf2 responses. Fourth, translational progress will likely depend less on maximizing gas dose and more on matching the right gas, timing, and delivery system to the right disease context. The purpose of this expanded review is therefore not simply to summarize gas biology, but to compare mechanistic logics and identify the degree to which multi-gas strategies are conceptually justified (Figure 1).

【Introduction · section-2-p1】Aerobic life depends on tightly regulated redox chemistry. Reactive oxygen species and reactive nitrogen species are not merely toxic by-products of metabolism; at physiological levels, they function as second messengers that shape proliferation, differentiation, immunity, metabolism, and tissue repair.1 Oxidative distress emerges when the rate, location, or persistence of reactive species exceeds the buffering capacity of antioxidant and repair systems, causing damage to lipids, proteins, and nucleic acids.2 Because this transition from signaling to injury is controlled rather than accidental, cellular defense systems must continuously discriminate between useful redox inputs and harmful ones.3

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Therapeutic gases and the Nrf2/Keap1 pathway: direct thiol modification vs . indirect modulation》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Biomarkers, Mechanistic Bottlenecks, and Experimental Priorities · section-11-p1】One reason mechanistic debates persist is that the field still lacks sufficiently precise in vivo readouts. Many studies infer gas action from downstream antioxidant enzyme expression, total glutathione, or bulk oxidative stress markers. These are useful but indirect. A stronger mechanistic program requires real-time or residue-resolved detection of S-nitrosylation, persulfidation, oxidized phospholipid mediators, and subcellular redox shifts in the same biological system.3940

【Biomarkers, Mechanistic Bottlenecks, and Experimental Priorities · section-11-p2】For Nrf2 specifically, researchers often stop at nuclear translocation or induction of HO-1, NQO1, or GCLC. These markers are important but not sufficient to distinguish canonical Keap1 cysteine sensing from noncanonical autophagy- or kinase-driven activation. Nor can they separate direct gas chemistry from secondary changes in mitochondrial function or inflammatory burden. Future work should therefore combine transcriptional readouts with residue-level Keap1 modification mapping, reporter systems for compartmental redox status, and experimental designs that manipulate upstream kinases or autophagy nodes in parallel.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Therapeutic gases and the Nrf2/Keap1 pathway: direct thiol modification vs . indirect modulation》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Conclusion · section-13-p1】NO, H2S, and H2 do not converge on the Nrf2/Keap1 axis by identical routes. NO and H2S are redox-active signaling molecules whose access to Keap1 is grounded in direct or near-direct cysteine chemistry, whereas H2 appears to influence the pathway mainly through indirect remodeling of oxidative propagation, mitochondrial function, and stress-responsive signaling networks.111922 Recognizing this asymmetry is essential for accurate mechanistic interpretation.

【Conclusion · section-13-p2】At the same time, these differences do not negate convergence. The three gases repeatedly stabilize overlapping adaptive states characterized by improved antioxidant defense, preserved mitochondrial quality, reduced inflammatory amplification, and enhanced stress tolerance. Nrf2 is a central translator of these states because it connects thiol sensing to transcriptional programs governing detoxification, metabolism, proteostasis, and organelle homeostasis.332

【The Nrf2/Keap1 Axis Is a Cysteine-Sensitive Signaling Hub · section-4-p3】The so-called cysteine code is especially relevant for gas biology. Keap1 contains many cysteines, but they are not equivalent. Cys151 is particularly associated with sensing reactive electrophiles and changes near the BTB-Cul3 interface, whereas Cys273 and Cys288 often emerge in models involving larger conformational effects on substrate orientation and repression efficiency.345
